integrity: The theorem is derived from radial Krylov span and an exact ball-indicator orthogonality argument. Verification uses rational full-matrix projections, not finite-sample inference for the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic unrestarted GMRES, root point source, finite radially weighted rooted trees, common positive leaf grounding only; no nonradial, finite-precision or restarted claims. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact graph-ball residuals for GMRES on radially weighted grounded trees
